settings.heading: Aromatheory
settings.text: How fragrance shapes mood, memory and the way a space is experienced.

settings.heading: Scent is the fastest route to memory
settings.content:
Smell is the only sense wired directly to the brain's emotional and memory centres. A well-chosen fragrance can calm a waiting room, energise a studio or make a hotel lobby unforgettable.

Aromatheory is our approach to choosing the right scent, in the right strength, for the right space.

settings.title: Top notes
settings.text: The first impression. Light, fresh and volatile â€” citrus, herbs and light florals that greet you within minutes.

settings.title: Heart notes
settings.text: The character of the fragrance. Florals, spices and fruits that emerge as the top notes fade and define the scent's personality.

settings.title: Base notes
settings.text: The lasting memory. Woods, resins and musks that anchor the blend and linger long after diffusion.

settings.heading: Top, Heart & Base Notes
settings.subheading: Every fragrance unfolds in three stages.

settings.title: Fresh & Green
settings.text: Clean, crisp and energising. Ideal for lobbies, offices and clinics.

settings.title: Floral
settings.text: Soft, elegant and welcoming. Perfect for spas, salons and homes.

settings.title: Woody & Amber
settings.text: Warm, rich and grounding. Suits hotels, lounges and boutiques.

settings.heading: Choose by Mood & Space
settings.subheading: Match the character of a scent to the feeling you want to create.

settings.heading: Diffusion that keeps the oil intact
settings.content: Our waterless diffusers break pure fragrance oil into microscopic particles using cold air â€” no heat, no water, no dilution. The scent you choose is the scent you smell, evenly and consistently across the room.

settings.question: How do I choose the right scent for my space?
settings.answer: Start with the mood you want to create, then consider the size and use of the room. Our team is happy to recommend a blend â€” just send us a message.

settings.question: How long does a fragrance oil last?
settings.answer: That depends on the diffuser setting and room size. Most commercial setups run for several weeks per bottle.

settings.question: Are your oils safe for sensitive environments?
settings.answer: All SFRA fragrance oils are phthalate and nitromusk free and tested in line with IFRA safety standards.
